decks.notes: This deck focuses on playing aggressively with low-cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while also utilizing powerful spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt to control the board. The synergy between Mishra's Bauble and Dragon's Rage Channeler allows for card advantage and fueling the graveyard for delve spells. Counterspell and Archmage's Charm provide protection and disruption, while Expressive Iteration helps dig for key cards. The mana base is streamlined to support the deck's tempo-driven game plan, making it a quick and efficient aggro deck in the Modern format.

The deck focuses on efficiently controlling the game by using a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage engines. It aims to establish a solid board presence with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, while also utilizing powerful threats such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Omnath, Locus of Creation. The deck also includes powerful value cards like Yorion, Sky Nomad and expressive iteration to generate card advantage. Additionally, the mana base is carefully constructed to support the multiple colors necessary for the deck's spells and threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Iona, Shield of Emeria. It includes control elements like Force of Negation and Remand to protect the combo pieces, while also using versatile spells like Prismari Command and Fire / Ice for flexibility. Wrenn and Six provide additional value by recurring lands, and Teferi, Time Raveler helps disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to be creative in its approach, combining combo elements with control and versatility to outmaneuver opponents.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of powerful planeswalkers, creature tutors, and ramp spells to quickly set up a dominating board presence. By searching for key creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Cultivator Colossus, and leveraging the abilities of cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Tameshi, Reality Architect, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. The inclusion of powerful land cards like Ketria Triome and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional versatility and resilience to the deck's game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing a wide range of control spells, creatures, and planeswalkers to dominate the game. By leveraging cards like Yorion, Sky Nomad for value and incremental advantage, the player can control the board with removal spells like Solitude and Prismatic Ending, while also generating card advantage with cards like Wrenn and Six. The deck aims to control the game through a mix of removal, card advantage, and versatile threats, ultimately overwhelming the opponent and securing victory through careful resource management and strategic decision-making.

The deck focuses on utilizing Elementals' abilities to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It includes creatures with powerful ETB effects, as well as spells to remove threats and protect your own creatures. Aether Vial allows for instant speed creature deployment, while the Elemental synergy with cards like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of the Roil can generate card advantage and value. The mana base is designed to support the Elemental tribal theme, providing a mix of colors and tribal support with cards like Cavern of Souls.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana and abuse the synergy with Amulet of Vigor to get Primeval Titan onto the battlefield as fast as possible. With Primeval Titan, the deck can quickly search for key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and combo off to deal massive damage to the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Azusa, Lost but Seeking and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove helps to further accelerate the mana production and ensure the combo can be executed efficiently.

This Modern Goblins deck focuses on utilizing a variety of aggressive and efficient Goblin creatures to overwhelm opponents quickly. With cards like Conspicuous Snoop, Goblin Ringleader, and Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker, the deck aims to generate value and create a wide board presence. The deck also includes removal options like Munitions Expert and Warren Weirding to deal with threats. Aether Vial helps to cheat creatures into play, while mana fixing lands like Cavern of Souls and Bloodstained Mire ensure smooth mana progression. With a focus on aggression and synergy among Goblins, this deck aims to win swiftly in 1 vs 1 matches.

This aggro deck focuses on quickly ramping up and casting powerful creatures with a mix of colors. It utilizes cards like Lightning Helix and Tribal Flames for direct damage, while also having access to big creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Worldspine Wurm for finishing blows. The deck also includes ways to search for specific creatures with Eladamri's Call and Eldritch Evolution. Overall, the strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of fast, aggressive creatures and big, hard-hitting threats.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to bring out powerful, game-winning creatures like Primeval Titan. It utilizes cards like Amulet of Vigor and Azusa, Lost but Seeking to generate extra mana and lands in play. The key strategy involves using lands like Urza's Saga and Castle Garenbrig to cheat out big threats early in the game. With the right setup, the deck can overwhelm opponents with explosive plays and combo off for a quick victory. The combo potential of the deck makes it a formidable force in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on using a toolbox of creatures with various abilities to create a combo that generates value and generates incremental advantage. By utilizing cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide alongside creatures like Blood Artist and Geralf's Messenger, the deck can create a loop of sacrificing creatures, generating tokens, and draining opponents' life. This strategy allows the deck to control the board while also pressuring opponents and gaining incremental advantage over time. Additionally, the deck includes various mana dorks and mana fixing lands to ensure consistent ramp and color fixing.

The deck focuses on using Cascade mechanics to quickly put multiple threats onto the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent with aggressive plays. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to Cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Bonecrusher Giant, the deck aims to create a fast-paced, high-pressure game plan. The inclusion of disruptive spells like Force of Negation and versatile removal options like Fire/Ice adds an element of control to the aggro strategy, allowing the deck to handle opposing threats while maintaining its aggressive game plan.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a variety of counterspells and removal spells while applying pressure with efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. By leveraging card advantage and tempo plays with cards like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Time Raveler, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and maintain board control until it can finish the game. The mana base is designed to support the deck's powerful spells and ensure consistency in casting its spells on curve.

The deck focuses on utilizing graveyard recursion and self-mill effects to quickly assemble a combo win condition. By milling cards like Vengevine and Thassa's Oracle, the deck aims to use cards like Undercity Informer and Balustrade Spy to put key pieces directly into play. The inclusion of Sword of the Meek and Salvage Titan add additional synergy and resilience to the combo. This landless deck is designed to be highly efficient and aggressive, aiming to win the game quickly through its powerful combo interactions.

This deck utilizes a mix of control elements and powerful Elemental creatures to disrupt opponents while generating value through card advantage and mana ramp. The key strategy revolves around triggering Elemental synergies and leveraging powerful control spells to outpace and outvalue opponents. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value by blinking permanents for extra card advantage. The deck aims to control the board state while steadily building towards a powerful late-game win condition with cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Risen Reef.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence by playing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent with spells like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt. It also utilizes cards that help dig through the deck quickly like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to maintain consistent pressure. The deck aims to control the game in its favor by combining tempo playstyle with powerful threats that can end the game quickly if left unchecked.
